subject: The tree on the hill
body:
I've been reading up on the King. He lives all alone at a huge royal tree and he is not very nice.

In the middle of a fight he'll shout out Decrees, like KNEEL or DO NOT RUN or COME NO CLOSER. Whatever he says, do it fast. If you break one your hearts get cut in half for 30 seconds. I put where to find him in your Archive.

Your old friend,
Dr. T

@archive:antarchy:king
